attribution.title: CREA, Nieuwe Achtergracht 170, Amsterdam: student cultural centre in the former Diamantslijperij Maatschappij works
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell for roofs and back walls (CC BY 4.0): the brick canal front of the former diamond-cutting works with its segmental-headed windows, stone string courses, white cornice and set-back glass storey, the arched stone entrance lettered DIAMANTSLIJPERIJ with the vertical CREA sign, and the white-rendered south block. Measured from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
